description.zh: 说明：描述长度不能大于100,需进行UTF-8格式的URLEncode编码
description.en: The description. The value can be up to 100 characters long and must be URL-encoded in UTF-8.
The ID of the call center.

description.zh: 说明：同一企业外呼组编号不能重复，外呼组编号长度为2-20，以字母开头，须同时且只能包含字母和数字，同一企业最多可创建1000个外呼组。
description.en: The outbound group number, which must be unique within an enterprise. The number must be 2 to 20 characters long, start with a letter, and contain only letters and digits. An enterprise can have a maximum of 1,000 agent groups.

description.zh: 说明：外呼组名称不能为空，长度不能大于50,需进行UTF-8格式的URLEncode编码
description.en: The outbound group name. The name cannot be empty, must not exceed 50 characters, and must be URL-encoded in UTF-8.
